x.hook: Shared liquidity pools always socialize bad debt.
x.copy:
Pooled lending forces prime capital to underwrite degenerate positions. On Stellar Soroban, Vanna isolates risk at the contract boundary using per-user SmartAccounts. One account blows through its 1.10x Health Factor floor, zero contagion spills over to your deposits.

Liquidations execute at ~320ms Mercury indexer latency with 0.00014 XLM fixed gas. Your risk remains mathematically sandboxed.

Deploy your testnet SmartAccount sandbox at test.stellar.vanna.finance

linkedin.hook: The structural flaw of decentralized credit is pooled counterparty risk.
linkedin.copy:
Institutional liquidity providers historically avoid pooled money markets for a clear operational reason: shared insolvency risk. When an illiquid asset depegs in a pooled architecture, the protocol socializes that bad debt across every LP. Governance votes and multi-collateral buckets cannot fix fundamentally commingled balance sheets.

We built Vanna on Stellar Soroban using isolated per-user SmartAccounts to guarantee deterministic risk boundaries. Every borrower operates inside an isolated contract instance. If a counterparty breaches their 1.10x Health Factor floor, the liquidation engine clears that specific position without touching surrounding accounts. Capital never pools into a single commingled state where bad debt can cascade.

Combined with real-time state tracking via ~320ms Mercury indexer latency and 0.00014 XLM fixed gas overhead, institutional balance sheets get predictable execution without pooled underwriting exposure. Deploy your testnet SmartAccount sandbox at test.stellar.vanna.finance.

reddit.hook: Why we chose isolated SmartAccounts over pooled liquidity for Vanna on Soroban
reddit.copy:
Most lending protocols inherited pooled accounting because early EVM gas costs made isolated contract deployment per user completely impractical. In 2020, spinning up isolated proxy contracts for every single position was a non-starter. The trade-off was pooled risk, where tail-risk collateral collapses and dilutes every conservative lender in the pool.

On Stellar Soroban, that trade-off no longer makes sense. Vanna runs an isolated SmartAccount pattern where each position lives in its own contract boundary. When a borrower breaches the 1.10x Health Factor floor, the liquidation engine unwinds that specific vault. There is zero accounting path for that deficit to contaminate unrelated liquidity providers.

The performance footprint makes this practical on testnet today. Position state updates sit at ~320ms Mercury indexer latency, and execution costs run at 0.00014 XLM fixed gas. Liquidators do not get priced out by fee market spikes, and institutional capital does not underwrite anonymous risk.

Deploy your testnet SmartAccount sandbox at test.stellar.vanna.finance

Disclosure: I am a core contributor building lending infrastructure at Vanna Protocol.
